name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
notes: First pass, national and entity level; sparse web record. Geography: 2 entities, Brčko District, 10 FBiH cantons and 142 municipalities plus the city of Istočno Sarajevo (79 FBiH under their cantons, 64 Republika Srpska) taken from Wikipedia's municipality list and cantonal membership, with ISO 3166-2:BA codes for entities and cantons; municipalities carry no code because no official coded list was fetched. All 64 RS local units are listed (Istočno Sarajevo city added). Map: 142 municipal shapes (2020 layer; the city of Istočno Sarajevo and Stanari have no separate shape and are not drawn) matched by the dataset's own municipality IDs (BIH_nnn) written in the code column of geo_units.csv; these are not official codes, so replace them when the Agency for Statistics list is open. Shapes: Glaurdić, Kaniški, Budimir & Ondrejka, Spatial Data of Municipalities in Yugoslavia and Its Successor States 1970-2020 (ELWar project, GESIS / University of Luxembourg, doi 10.7802/2358), 2020 layer, CC BY 4.0; made from the official gazettes, not OpenStreetMap. Eurostat GISCO LAU 2024 has no BA units; HDX has no COD-AB; geoBoundaries is ODbL. Follow-up needed for the Agency for Statistics municipality codes and an open map. No Seats tab: no supporter verified as sitting today. Round 2 checked Eurostat GISCO LAU 2023: it has no BA or ME units, so no map.
